problem_statement: The ztimer subsystem needs functions to measure the overhead of its timer operations. Provide ztimer_overhead_set(ztimer_clock_t *clock, uint32_t base) that returns the overhead in ticks beyond the requested base interval for the timer-callback operation, and ztimer_overhead_sleep(ztimer_clock_t *clock, uint32_t base) that returns the overhead in ticks beyond the requested base interval for the timer-sleep operation. Provide a ztimer_auto_adjust module that, during ztimer initialization, when no adjust values have been configured for the board, measures the overhead of both operations and stores the results in the adjust_set and adjust_sleep fields of ZTIMER_USEC. When board-configured values are present, those must be used instead of measuring. The test clears the adjust fields, manually measures both overheads, and verifies that the auto-adjust values (set before the test clears them) are within 1 tick of the manually measured values.

verification.reason: The statement provides all function names with signatures, the module name, the fields used, the required behavior (auto-measure vs. configured values), and the test's verification criteria (within 1 tick). The only flagged name, CONFIG_MODULE_ZTIMER_AUTO_ADJUST, is standard RIOT Kconfig naming derivable from the stated module name 'ztimer_auto_adjust'.
